verdicts.reason: B keeps the original's look: the striped image runs off the right edge and is offset from a left-aligned type column. Its flaws are a large empty block to the lower left of the strips and the address sitting only about 15px above the first strip. A turns the image into a centred block with margins, so it loses the right-edge bleed, and the strips' left edge (about 68px) doesn't line up with the text margin (about 30px). A also has the same cramped gap between the date/address and the image.
